body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose two willing creatures within 5 units. Until your next turn, each knows the other's location and may communicate silently.

surges.html: Increase the link's range by 2 units.
Choose one additional willing creature within range to join the link.

rider.title: RESONANCE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the link lasts until the end of the encounter unless broken by distance greater than 8 units.
